name: pricing-calculator
description: Interactive ROI calculator card: range sliders (people, hourly cost, tracked asset value, weekly manual hours) beside an annual-return panel with a gradient total, a three-row breakdown, an ROI note and a button, plus a centred sales line below. Live: `.ap-roi-calculator-section` on /new-pricing/. Stands alone (no dependency on the pricing hero); every number, rate and label is a prop and behaviour.js recomputes on input. Model: hours saved = round(hours/wk x weeks x time_saved_pct% x people / people_baseline); labour = round(hours saved x hourly); loss prevented = round(asset value x loss_pct%); total = labour + loss prevented.

inputs_label.description: Small caps label over the sliders, e.g. Your Inputs.

sliders.description: One entry per slider. Each: key (people | hourly | assets | hours — the model input it drives), label, min, max, step, value (starting value), pill (value chip text, {n} = the formatted value, e.g. "{n} people"), pill_one (chip text when the value is exactly 1), format (raw | number | currency | money_short; default per key: assets money_short, others raw), min_label, max_label (the scale ends under the track).

results_label.description: Small caps purple label over the results, e.g. Your Annual Return.

total_label.description: Caption above the total, e.g. Estimated Annual Value Reclaimed.

rows.description: Breakdown rows. Each: key (hours | labor | loss — the computed value shown), icon (time | money | shield), title, note, value (text with {n} = the formatted value; default "{n}", live hours row "{n} hrs").

roi_text.description: Centred note under the breakdown. Wrap words in *asterisks* to set them bold purple, e.g. Asset Panda customers see an average *800% return* on their investment.

cta_label.description: Button text. Renders only with cta_url.

footer_link_label.description: Green link after the footer line, e.g. Talk to Sales. Renders only with footer_link_url.

time_saved_pct.description: Share of manual tracking time Asset Panda saves, in percent.

loss_pct.description: Share of total asset value protected from loss each year, in percent.

people_baseline.description: Team size the weekly hours describe; the people slider scales hours saved by people / people_baseline.

variant.description: classic: the live /new-pricing/ port (unchanged). 2026: the Figma 'Pricing - New Jun 11 2026' card (node 7169:88817) — on the white page, a soft centred indigo/green gradient splash behind a frosted-glass card (80% white over a backdrop blur, QA 2026-10-29), Figma's compact type (12px caps labels, 15px slider and row titles, 13px notes), the Figma breakdown icons, AA-contrast greys, a live total for screen readers and an arrow on the sales link.

disclaimer.description: Small print centred under the sales line, e.g. the calculator's estimate disclaimer. Empty renders nothing.
